annotations.title: Say what a change does to steps

description: Replace a change's effects: for each step it reaches (workflowPageId + nodeId from compass_workflow_steps — a sub-workflow's steps included), one of eliminate, automate (reviewMinutes: what a person still spends checking), parallelize (its wait comes off the critical path), relax_gate (keepShare: share of the wait left, default 0.25), assist (keepShare: share of hands-on time left, default 0.5), reassign (toSubjectPageId). Eliminating or automating every step of a sub-workflow collapses the step that is that sub-workflow. Then project with compass_workflow_rollup changeIds. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response, after the user has approved. Omit on the first call.

opportunityId.description: The change's key (e.g. ACME-12) or id.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
